analysis: Execution succeeded, but the hypothesis did not improve validation: pinned host macro HR@10 was 0.6112 versus the supplied 0.6213 reference, a decrease of 0.0101. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.665, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.635, Electronics 0.450, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.695. Electronics also declined from the supplied 0.465 reference. Thus, adding recent intent to the attention query was unsuccessful in this trial; these results do not establish why. Zero initialization preserves the query formula initially, but adding a layer consumes initialization RNG and can change subsequent initial weights, limiting attribution solely to the learned query branch. No improvement claim is supported.
code_summary: Trains one independent LightGCN model per category with three propagation layers and 64-dimensional embeddings. Training masks supervised graph edges and uses prefix histories, sampled-negative cross-entropy, embedding regularization, and Adam. History encoding combines a residual causal convolution, relative-position attention, and gated fusion with the graph-user vector. This trial adds a zero-initialized, bias-free projection of the last valid contextualized event to the attention query, explicitly zeroing empty-history contributions. Diagnostics cover gradients, masking, last-valid selection, finite outputs, and serialization parity. Versioned metadata and the predictor reconstruct and strictly load exactly one selected checkpoint per category; no ensemble or separately fitted scorer is used.
